one_line: There are infinitely many finite abelian groups with solid non-maximal-supplement sets of size (1+o(1))|G|^{1/4}, so the fourth-root exponent in Theorem 5 is optimal, while its logarithmic factor remains unresolved.
caveats: This leaves a factor (log |G|)^{1/4} between the known guarantee and the obstruction, and novelty beyond the supplied literature search was not independently checked.
